name: Bunny ears
blurb: Long rabbit ears on headbands and hoods: upright, floppy and lop-eared styles
title: Bunny Ears: Headband, Hood & Ear Shape Drawing Reference
description: Bunny ears reference: rabbit ear headbands and hoods, upright, floppy and lop styles, how to draw long ear shapes and how to pose with them.
answer: Bunny ears are long rabbit-style ears worn on a headband or hood, or drawn as part of a character. They come in upright, bent and floppy lop-eared styles, and they give a soft, gentle or bouncy look. In Japanese fandom they are called usamimi.

sections.h: What bunny ears bring to a character
body: Rabbits suggest softness, shyness and energy at the same time, so bunny ears suit characters who are gentle, easily startled or full of bounce. Because the ears are long, they exaggerate every head movement, which makes them very expressive in animation.
As an accessory, bunny ears appear with pajamas, hoodies, spring and Easter themes and Year of the Rabbit designs.

ul: Upright: both ears straight up, alert and lively.
One ear bent: one ear folds over at the middle, playful and casual.
Lop ears: both ears hang down beside the face, gentle and sleepy.
Hood ears: long, soft ears sewn on a hoodie or onesie hood, often droopy.
Wired headband: ears can be bent into any angle and hold the shape.
Ribbon-style ears: a large bow tied on the head with long, ear-like loops.

body: Bunny ears are long ovals, narrow at the base, widest a little past the middle and rounded at the tip. Draw them as slightly curved, thick shapes rather than flat strips, with a shallow inner hollow in a lighter or pinker colour.

Attach them at the top of the head, closer together than cat ears. Their length makes them follow motion: when the character runs or jumps, the ears trail behind and bend; when she tilts her head, they swing to one side. Lop ears hang from the top of the head and rest on the hair, so draw a small bend where they turn downward. Keep the ear length consistent between drawings; it is easy to let them grow or shrink.

sections.h: Wearing and posing with bunny ears
body: For cosplayers, wired ears let you add a bend for a softer look, and matching the headband to the wig helps it blend. Tall ears can catch on doors and be cropped in photos, so plan extra headroom in each frame.

Bunny-themed poses: hands curled near the chest like front paws, a small hop, peeking out from behind a corner or holding a carrot plush. Pastel backgrounds, spring flowers and soft daylight suit the style.

faq.q: What are bunny ears called in Japanese?
What is the difference between cat ears and bunny ears in drawing?
faq.a: Cat ears are short triangles placed toward the sides of the head; bunny ears are long, rounded ovals placed closer together on top and move much more.

faq.q: How do I make bunny ears flop?
faq.a: Use a headband with wire inside the ears and bend it, or choose a soft, unwired pair that hangs naturally.
